feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping proposal-screen features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose in the Valentine app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining OKLCH theme variables, dark mode tokens, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page mounting the SPA root and loading the main React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the ValentineExperience component.
frontend/src/components/valentine/FinalS: Displays the final romantic photo screen with message, animated hearts, and footer attribution.
frontend/src/components/valentine/firewo: Canvas-based fireworks animation with particles, physics, and periodic firework launches.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Firewo: Shows fireworks animation and auto-transitions to the final screen after 5 seconds.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Propos: Valentine proposal UI with YES button and an evasive NO button that moves and changes labels on interaction.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Valent: Manages the three-phase flow: proposal, fireworks, and final screen.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and managing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and loading stored identities. Wraps AuthClient creation with custom options and exposes status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and extensive OKLCH color variables for a romantic light/dark theme, along with global typography and styling rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to OKLCH CSS variables, extended theme settings, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature definitions, and high-level description for a romantic Valentine proposal web experience.
